gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ca: Heat transfer: exchangers, reboilers, air coolers and fired heaters
Pumps, compressors, ejectors and steam turbines
Stirred, trickle-bed and ebullated-bed reactors, the FCC converter and the delayed coker
Boilers and gasifiers for coal, biomass or waste
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.eq: Stands on a slotted skirt, its outlet line leaving through the opening towards you; place up to 6 side connections
Lies on two saddles, along or across the constructor's facing; place up to 6 side connections

Trays and platforms on a skirt, the bottoms leaving through the skirt's port; feed and bottoms face you, reflux and pumparounds your right, draws, steam and the reboiler return your left. Build its exchangers, reboiler and ejector as units and run the pipes; or import a column calculator's design

A shell-and-tube exchanger (TEMA AES) on two saddles: the tube side in at the bottom of the channel towards you and out at its top, the shell side in on top and out underneath. Size its shell and tubes; condensers, coolers and heaters are exchangers
A kettle on two saddles: the heating medium through the tube bundle (channel towards you), liquid fed underneath, vapour leaving on top and the product over the weir at the back head
A bank of forced-draught bays, side by side in parallel and one behind the other in series, fans blowing up through each bundle; one inlet on top at the front, one outlet underneath at the back
An ejector standing on its own frame: suction towards you, motive steam on top, discharge downwards; sized by its suction

An overhung process pump (API 610 OH2) on its baseplate and plinth: suction towards you along the shaft, discharge up over the casing, the motor behind a coupling guard; sized by its discharge. Drawn only: the one-block pump pumps

A balanced-opposed compressor (API 618) on a steel table: 2, 4 or 6 double-acting cylinders on both sides of its frame, a suction bottle over each side's cylinders fed by one suction header over the machine (suction on top) and a discharge bottle under them joined by one discharge header (discharge towards you), the motor behind; sized by its bore. Drawn only: the one-block compressor compresses

A fired heater (API 560) with a round radiant section on fireproofed legs, burners firing up through its floor, the convection section, breeching and stack on its roof; the convection coil in at the top of its front header box and out at its bottom, the radiant coil in under the roof and out over the floor (pipe the crossover between them), fuel gas under the floor, all towards you. Drawn only

A fired heater (API 560) with a box radiant section and a hipped roof on fireproofed legs, rows of burners firing up through its floor, the convection section along its roof and a stack every 15 m; longer than 24 m it is a twin cell, two radiant sections of half its length either side of an aisle under one convection section. The convection coil in at the top of its front header box and out at its bottom, the radiant coil into the left header box near its top and out of the right one over the floor (a twin's through manifolds across the aisle; pipe the crossover between them), fuel gas under the floor, all towards you. Drawn only
A jacketed reactor with a top-mounted agitator drive, hung from lugs on its operating deck: charge and vapour on the top head, product through the bottom valve, coolant in and out of the jacket
1 to 4 temperature-swing adsorber beds on skirts, joined by valved headers top and bottom: feed in and product out while the other beds regenerate on hot gas
A heavy-wall hydroprocessing reactor of 1 to 4 catalyst beds on a skirt: oil and hydrogen down from the top elbow, cold hydrogen quench between the beds, effluent out through the skirt

A residue hydrocracker whose catalyst bed is kept expanded by the ebullating pump under its bottom head, recycling liquid from above the bed; fresh catalyst added on top and spent catalyst drawn off on line
A horizontally split multistage compressor (API 617) driven by a motor through a step-up gear on a concrete table: suction and discharge down through the table, the lube-oil console at grade
A turbine-generator set on its plinth: steam in through the trip-and-throttle valve, exhaust up into a lower-pressure header, a gear and a generator
A turbine-generator set on a concrete table, its exhaust falling into the surface condenser underneath: steam in, cooling water through the condenser, condensate and air extraction out
1 to 4 high-efficiency cyclones in parallel on a frame: dusty gas in through the side inlet, clean gas out of the top, solids down through a rotary airlock

A side-by-side fluid catalytic cracker in its structure: feed injected into the riser, the reactor and stripper on top of it, the regenerator burning the coke off in air, the two joined by slide-valved standpipes
1 or 2 pairs of coke drums on a concrete table with their structure and cutting derricks: one drum fills with hot residue while its partner is steamed, quenched and its coke cut out by water jets
A boiler burning solid fuel in a fast-fluidized bed, the solids caught in hot cyclones and returned to the furnace: feedwater in, steam out, ash drained below, the flue gas to its own stack

A pressurised refractory-lined gasifier (HTW type): solid fuel through lock hoppers into a bubbling bed blown with oxygen or air and steam, the syngas cleaned in a cyclone and cooled in a steam-raising cooler
A stoker boiler burning solid fuel on a moving grate: fuel fed from day bins across its front, ash dropped into a drag-chain trough, feedwater in and steam out, the flue gas to its own stack

A Lurgi dry-bottom gasifier in its gasifier house: lump coal through the coal lock on top, oxygen and steam up through the turning grate, ash out through the ash lock, the raw gas washed in its wash cooler
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sh: Shell inside diameter, 0.5 to 2.5 m in 0.25 m steps; the bundle fills it, about 75 D² m² of tube surface per metre of tubes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.tu: Tube length in whole metres, at least three bundle diameters and 2 m: up to 12 m for an exchanger, 10 m for a kettle
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sh: Height of the shell's lowest point above the ground, 2 to 16 m; the bottom nozzles keep a block below them for their pipes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.bu: Tube bundle diameter, 0.5 to 2 m in 0.25 m steps; the kettle's shell is 1.6 times it, leaving the vapour space over the boiling pool
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ke: Height of the kettle's lowest point above the ground, 2 to 16 m; the bottom nozzles keep a block below them for their pipes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ba: Width across the tubes × length from header to header, 1.5 to 3 m by 3 to 6 m: only bays whose fans can cover 40 % of the bundle (API 661)
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pa: Bays side by side sharing the flow, 1 to 6: an inlet manifold over their first headers and an outlet manifold behind their last join them
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.se: Bays one behind the other, 1 to 4: the flow passes each in turn, crossover spools join each back header to the next front header
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.bu: Height of the tube bundle's bottom above the ground, 3 to 16 m, leaving the fans and their motors room underneath
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.su: Suction nozzle diameter, 0.05 to 1 m in 0.05 m steps; the ejector is 8.3 times as long; one of 0.2 m or less hangs on a single post
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.di: Height of the discharge flange above the ground, 1 to 16 m
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pu: Discharge nozzle diameter, 0.05 to 0.75 m in 0.05 m steps; the suction is one size larger, the impeller, casing and motor follow. Up to 0.4 m an overhung pump, larger an axially split one with both nozzles to the sides
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.bo: Cylinder bore, 0.15 to 1.2 m in 0.05 m steps; the stroke, cylinders, bottles, headers, steel table and motor follow
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.th: Cylinders, 2 to 10, in opposed pairs on both sides of the frame so their forces balance
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fo: Height of the steel table under the frame; at least as high as keeps the discharge bottles 0.3 m over the ground
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ra: Radiant section diameter, 2.5 to 12 m in 0.5 m steps
Radiant section height in whole metres, 1.5 to 2.75 diameters (API 560), 4 m at least and 20 m at most (vertical tubes reach about 18 m)
Radiant section width, 4 to 12 m in 1 m steps; the walls stand 1 m higher than it is wide
Radiant section length in whole metres, 1.2 widths and 6 m at least, up to 48 m; above 24 m a twin cell, two sections of half the length side by side; one stack per 15 m of a cell
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.he: Height of the floor above the ground, 3 to 16 m: the burners hang under it and need room to stand beneath them
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.su: Outside surface of the bundle's tubes: about 1,260 D² tubes of 3/4 inch on a 1 inch pitch, 75 D² m² per metre of tubes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ke: The kettle's shell over its bundle (1.6 times), and the outside surface of the bundle's tubes
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ba: The bank's bundle face between its headers, which the air crosses, and the fans under it
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ej: From the steam chest to the diffuser's exit: 8.3 suction diameters
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pu: Liquid at 3 m/s in the discharge; the shaft power at a 100 m head of water and 70 % efficiency
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.di: Swept volume of the double-acting cylinders per hour at the frame's speed; the gas delivered is less by the volumetric efficiency
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.he: Heat to the process: the radiant tubes at 35 kW/m² on average, the radiant section taking 70 % of the duty (API 560 practice)
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ax: Along (lengthwise) or across (crosswise) the constructor's facing
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.im: Take the trays, feed, side draws, pumparounds, steam and diameter of the nearest column calculator within %s blocks
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.tr: Number of trays, 1 to 64, 0.6 m apart; the column's height follows from them
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fe: Where the feed enters, counted from the top: tray 1 sits under the condenser, the last stage (trays + 1) is the sump
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.di: Inside diameter of the shell in 0.5 m steps: 0.5 to 10 m for a drum, up to 15 m for a column
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ta: Straight shell between the two head seams (tangent to tangent), 1 to 64 m. Each 2:1 head adds a quarter of the diameter
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sk: Height from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m, at least enough to enclose the head. The default leaves about 1 m under the head for the bottom outlet line, which leaves through the skirt's opening; slots show the inside
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.bo: A water boot under the far end, inboard of the far saddle: free water settles into it and leaves by the drain at its bottom. The saddles rise until the drain's pipe has a block above the ground. A drum too short to keep it clear of its saddles has none
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.sa: Height of the shell's lowest point above the ground, 1 to 16 m. The two saddles sit a fifth of the length in from each head seam
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fo: Blocks from the constructor to the vessel's near side, 1 to 16; 1 puts it right next to the constructor
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ri: Moves the vessel sideways, in blocks: to your right as you look from the constructor towards it, to your left when negative
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.up: Raises the vessel's ground above the constructor's level, in blocks; lowers it when negative
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ex: Height of the vessel's top above its ground, and its length along the axis over both heads
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.vo: Inside volume of the shell and heads, which is the reservoir's capacity, and the outside area of the shell and heads
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ce: Blocks the vessel takes: shell cells carry the drawn wall, interior cells are the space inside it
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.st: Build needs every cell of the ghost free; blocks in the way are outlined red in the world
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.co: Inlets and outlets on the drum's shell, up to 6: the side each faces, its height (a lying drum's place along it) and its offset across the shell; a lying drum's water boot and its drain
Which side connection the rows below edit
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fa: The side the nozzle faces as you look from the constructor: front (towards you), left, back, right, and on a lying drum top and bottom. Click to turn it
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.he: Height of the nozzle's centre line above the vessel's ground, m, at block centres; it stays at least 0.1 m inside the head seams
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.al: Distance of the nozzle's centre line from the end of the front head (the liquid outlet's end), m, at block centres; it stays at least 0.1 m inside the head seams
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.of: Moves the nozzle off the centre line across the shell, in whole blocks: a hillside nozzle, its pipe parallel to a centred one. The further out, the smaller the largest pipe
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ad: Places a new side connection where it meets nothing: a standing drum's as high as it goes, a lying drum's nearest its front head. Up to %s
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.re: Takes the selected side connection away
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.co: Neck up to %s m at the shell

The widest neck the shell carries where the nozzle stands: its edge stays 0.05 m inside the head seams and within the shell's curve. Any pipe connects: the nozzle's flange takes the pipe's size, a larger pipe's neck widening in a reducer just outside the vessel
A side connection is an inlet, or an outlet drawing all phases together; the top outlet draws vapour first, the bottom outlet liquid
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pa: Colours of the metal parts: primary for the body, secondary for the structure, from the palette or your own
Edit the primary colour: shell, heads, cladding and a unit's casings
Edit the secondary colour: skirt, saddles and steelwork
RAL colours seen on process plants; click one to paint the edited part
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.cu: Any colour as #RRGGBB: it paints the edited part once six digits are typed
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.pa: The configured colours (createcheme-common.toml, equipment; built-in RAL 9006 on RAL 7031)
Pipes, flanges and rails keep theirs
Pipes, flanges, nozzles, gratings, handrails, motors and actuators keep their own colours
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.cl: Build waits until no side connection meets another nozzle, the manway, the boot, a saddle or the ground, each at its largest pipe and flange
Connection %s has no room above the ground
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.st: Inside diameter of the shell, 1 to 4 m in 0.2 m steps; the jacket, heads, agitator drive, nozzles and operating deck follow
Height of the shell between its heads, whole metres from 0.7 to 2 diameters (1 m at least); the jacket covers it
Height of the bottom valve's outlet above the ground, 1 to 3 m; the operating deck stands on its columns at the lugs above it
Volume of the shell and its two heads; the motor about 4 kW times the volume in m³ to the power two thirds, as on DIN glass-lined reactors
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ad: Inside diameter of each bed vessel, 1 to 4.6 m in 0.2 m steps; the bed depth (2 diameters, 2.5 to 9 m), the lines, valves, headers and top platform follow
Bed vessels in the row, 1 to 4: one adsorbs while another regenerates, so a set runs without a stop from 2 beds
Height of the skirts under the beds, 2 to 4 m (3 m at least from 3.8 m): room under each bed for its bottom line, its flanges and the unloading nozzle
Adsorbent in each bed: the bed's cross-section times its depth of 2 diameters (2.5 to 9 m)
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.tr: Inside diameter of the shell, 1 to 5 m in 0.5 m steps. It sets the wall (a twentieth of it), each bed's depth (1.2 times it and 1 m, 7 m at most) and the nozzles
Catalyst beds, 1 to 4, one over the other with a cold hydrogen quench zone and a platform between each two. A single bed's quench line trims the inlet instead
Height from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m: at least half the diameter and 1.5 m, and from 2.5 m across enough for the effluent line to turn under the head to its port 1.5 m up
The catalyst the beds hold, each bed filling the shell's cross-section to its depth
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.eb: Inside diameter of the shell, 2.5 to 6 m in 0.5 m steps. It sets the wall (0.055 of it), the ebullating pump under the bottom head, its recycle lines and the two catalyst vessels
Straight shell between the head seams, 4 to 7 times the diameter in whole metres; about 5 times is usual. The expanded catalyst bed fills about 0.6 of it
Height of the open skirt from the ground to the bottom head seam, up to 16 m: at least enough for the pump and its canned motor under the head, with 1.2 m under the motor to lower it out
The liquid the ebullating pump returns under the grid to keep the catalyst bed expanded, about 4.5 cm/s up the reactor's cross-section, and the pump's shaft power against about 3.5 bar
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.ce: Impeller diameter, 0.3 to 1.5 m in 0.1 m steps; the casing (1.9 times as wide), bearings, nozzles, gear, motor, table and lube-oil console follow. The flow grows with its square
Impellers in the casing, 2 to 9; each lengthens the casing by 0.35 of the impeller diameter and adds head and shaft power, so the gear and motor grow with them
Height of the operating deck on the concrete table, 4 to 7 m in whole metres; at least 4 m, 5 m from a 0.5 m impeller and 6 m from 0.8 m, so the suction line's elbow and strainer fit under the slab
Inlet flow and shaft power scaled from a 0.65 m, four-impeller Elliott 32M4 (33,000 m³/h, 2.5 MW) with the impeller's area and the impellers; the speed keeps the impeller tips at 245 m/s
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.cy: Cyclone body diameter, 0.3 to 2 m in 0.1 m steps; Stairmand's high-efficiency proportions set the inlet, gas outlet, cylinder (1.5 diameters) and cone (2.5). From 1.2 m a roof walkway with a caged ladder
Cyclones in parallel, 1 to 4, a diameter and 1.5 m apart on common inlet and outlet headers; several drop their dust through their airlocks into one screw conveyor

Height of the cone's dust outlet flange above the ground, up to 8 m in whole metres; at least as high as hang the dipleg or hopper, the airlock and the conveyor, with the solids outlet a block over the ground
Air through all the cyclones at 20 m/s in their inlets; the cut size is the mineral dust (2.5 g/cm³) caught half the time (Lapple). Smaller cyclones catch finer dust
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.st: Outside diameter of the casing's exhaust end, 0.6 to 3 m in 0.1 m steps, about 5 MW per square metre of it; the steam chest, trip-and-throttle valve, gear and generator follow, and on the condensing set the condenser and its table

Turbine stages, 1 to 12; each lengthens the casing by 0.15 of its diameter. One stage is a single-stage turbine with hand valves on its steam chest; more carry 1 to 5 governor valves under a bar-lift bridge
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.co: Height of the operating deck on the concrete table, in whole metres up to 16; at least 2.4 times the casing and 0.5 m, and 4 m, and as high as hangs the condenser with its cooling-water inlet a block over the ground
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.st: Electrical output of a typical set of this casing (within a factor of two either way) and the turbine's speed, geared down to the 4-pole generator
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fc: Regenerator diameter outside the shell, 4 to 17 m in 0.5 m steps; its straight shell (1.5 D + 9 m), the feed whose coke it burns, the reactor and stripper, the riser, the standpipes, the slide valves and the structure follow

Riser length from its wye to its end inside the reactor, up to 44 m: 2 to 4 s of contact time. The shortest offered grows with the regenerator, 25 m at 4 m to 36 m at 17 m, so the spent catalyst still falls from the stripper, within 45° of vertical, over the longer run to the larger regenerator's bed

Height of the regenerator's bottom tangent above the ground, up to 14 m, on its concrete table: the lowest offered (8 to 11 m) leaves room for the air line's elbow under the bottom head and keeps both standpipes within 45° of vertical
Fresh feed the regenerator can burn the coke of, in m³/h and thousand barrels a day: its bed's area takes air at 0.6 to 1 m/s, about 50,000 barrels a day at 9.6 m across, in proportion to the area
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.de: Coke drum diameter outside the shell, 4 to 10 m in 0.5 m steps; the straight shell (2.5 D + 8 m, 29.3 m at most), the cone, the structure and the derricks follow
1 or 2 pairs of drums in one row, each pair with its switch valve: one drum fills while its partner is steamed, quenched and cut
Height of the drums' bottom flanges above the ground, 8 to 16 m: the unheading valves, the switch deck and the coke chutes hang under the concrete table
Coke %s t a drum, feed %s t/h
A drum's coke bed at 0.85 t/m³ filling the cone and three quarters of the straight shell; each pair fills one drum in 16 h at a coke yield of 30 % of the vacuum residue fed
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fl: Inside width of the furnace, 3 to 26 m in 1 m steps; its depth (0.65 of the width, 2.5 to 11 m), its height (20 to 45 m), the back pass, the fans, the fuel bins and the steel follow

Hot cyclones in a row on the furnace's rear wall, 1 to 4, sharing 0.85 of the width: only counts where none is wider than 8.7 m or a quarter of the furnace's height and the row fits the furnace's width and 2 m
Height of the grid above the ground, 5 to 8 m: the windbox, the bed-ash coolers and their conveyor stand under it, the feeder floor 4.5 m above it
About 3.3 MW per m² of grid, at most 950 MW: the bed circulates through the hot cyclones, the steam drum and the back pass take the heat, the fans blow the air in and draw the flue gas to the stack

Inside diameter of the gasifier, 1.5 to 6 m in 0.25 m steps; the shell (0.8 m wider), the height between its heads (12 m and 4 diameters), the cyclones (two over 4.5 m), the lock hoppers, the syngas cooler and the structure follow
Height of the vessel's bottom tangent line above the ground, from what the ash screw and the ash lock hopper under it need up to 16 m; the vessel stands on its support ring a third of the way up

About 24 MW per m² of bed (140 MW over a 2.75 m bed): oxygen or air and steam fluidize the bed under pressure, the fuel comes in through the lock hoppers and screws, the syngas leaves through the cyclones and the cooler
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.fi: Inside diameter of the gasifier, 2 to 5 m in 0.25 m steps; the vessel (3.1 times as tall between its heads), the coal and ash locks, the bunker and the gasifier house follow
Height of the ash lock's bottom valve above the ground, 3 to 5 m: its ash chute ends over a truck or a conveyor underneath

The vessel's inside diameter and its height between the heads: a water-jacketed pressure vessel holding a coal bed 3 to 4 m deep at about 30 bar; oxygen and steam rise through it from the turning grate, the jacket raising part of the steam
gui.createcheme.equipment_constructor.gr: Width of the grate, 2 to 12 m in 0.5 m steps; the furnace (12 to 36 m high), the feeders and the boiler follow: a bi-drum boiler up to 6 m wide, a single drum over a back pass above
Length of the grate from the feeders to the ash drop, 3 to 10 m: sets the furnace's depth, the feeders' stroke and the air plenums under the grate (3 to 5)
Height of the grate above the ground, 3 to 6 m: the siftings hoppers and the drag-chain ash trough stand under it, the firing aisle 1 m below it
%s MW of fuel, %s t/h of steam
Fuel burnt at 1.5 MW per square metre of grate; steam raised at 85 % boiler efficiency, 2.8 MJ for each kilogram from feedwater to superheated steam

gui.createcheme.vessel.radiant.cabin_hea: Radiant section %s m wide, %s m long

gui.createcheme.vessel.unit_support.kett: Kettle bottom %s m above the ground
gui.createcheme.vessel.unit_support.ejec: Discharge flange %s m above the ground
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.skirt: Vertical drum on a skirt, 2:1 heads
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.saddles: Horizontal drum on two saddles, 2:1 heads
gui.createcheme.vessel.kind.column: Distillation column of %s trays on a skirt, 2:1 heads

gui.createcheme.vessel.stirred_reactor.d: About %s m³, motor %s kW, agitator about %s rpm
gui.createcheme.vessel.unit_support.stir: Bottom valve outlet %s m above the ground

gui.createcheme.vessel.adsorber.platform: Top platform at %s m, top headers at %s m

Beds: %s, each %s m deep, about %s m³ of catalyst
gui.createcheme.vessel.ebullated_bed_rea: Shell %s m inside, %s m tangent to tangent, walls %s m thick
Ebullating pump casing %s m across, about %s m³/h at 3.5 bar, %s kW
